require 'openssl'
require 'socket'
require 'securerandom'
require 'base64'
require 'json'
require 'bcrypt'

module SecureSessionManager
  EPOCH_2020 = 1577836800
  MAX_SESSION_DURATION = 3600
  TOKEN_HMAC_KEY_LEN = 32

  class SessionToken
    attr_reader :user_id, :issued_at, :expires_at, :nonce, :hmac

    def initialize(user_id:, issued_at:, expires_at:, nonce:, hmac:)
      @user_id = user_id
      @issued_at = issued_at
      @expires_at = expires_at
      @nonce = nonce
      @hmac = hmac
    end

    def serialize
      payload = [@user_id.length, @user_id,
                 @issued_at, @expires_at,
                 @nonce].pack("na*NNa16")
      payload + @hmac
    end

    def self.deserialize(data)
      uid_len = data[0..1].unpack1('n')
      user_id = data[2...(2 + uid_len)]
      offset = 2 + uid_len
      issued_at, expires_at = data[offset...(offset + 8)].unpack('NN')
      offset += 8
      nonce = data[offset...(offset + 16)]
      hmac = data[(offset + 16)..-1]
      new(user_id: user_id, issued_at: issued_at,
          expires_at: expires_at, nonce: nonce, hmac: hmac)
    end
  end

  class TokenAuthority
    def initialize(secret_key)
      raise ArgumentError, "Key must be #{TOKEN_HMAC_KEY_LEN} bytes" unless secret_key.bytesize == TOKEN_HMAC_KEY_LEN
      @secret_key = secret_key.dup.freeze
      @revoked_tokens = {}
      @mutex = Mutex.new
    end

    def issue_token(user_id)
      raise ArgumentError, "user_id too long" if user_id.bytesize > 255
      raise ArgumentError, "user_id contains invalid chars" unless user_id.match?(/\A[a-zA-Z0-9._@-]+\z/)

      now = current_timestamp
      nonce = SecureRandom.random_bytes(16)
      expires_at = now + MAX_SESSION_DURATION

      hmac = compute_hmac(user_id, now, expires_at, nonce)
      SessionToken.new(user_id: user_id, issued_at: now,
                       expires_at: expires_at, nonce: nonce, hmac: hmac)
    end

    def validate_token(token)
      return { valid: false, reason: :invalid_format } unless token.is_a?(SessionToken)
      return { valid: false, reason: :revoked } if token_revoked?(token)

      expected_hmac = compute_hmac(token.user_id, token.issued_at,
                                   token.expires_at, token.nonce)
      unless secure_compare(expected_hmac, token.hmac)
        return { valid: false, reason: :invalid_signature }
      end

      unless valid_expiration?(token)
        return { valid: false, reason: :expired }
      end

      unless valid_duration?(token)
        return { valid: false, reason: :invalid_duration }
      end

      { valid: true, user_id: token.user_id, expires_at: token.expires_at }
    end

    def revoke_token(token)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        token_id = OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.digest(token.serialize)
        @revoked_tokens[token_id] = token.expires_at
      end
    end

    private

    def current_timestamp
      # Return absolute timestamp - no truncation needed since
      # Ruby integers have arbitrary precision
      Time.now.to_i
    end

    def valid_expiration?(token)
      now = current_timestamp
      # Direct comparison: token must expire in the future
      # and not more than MAX_SESSION_DURATION from now
      token.expires_at > now && token.expires_at <= now + MAX_SESSION_DURATION
    end

    def valid_duration?(token)
      duration = token.expires_at - token.issued_at
      duration > 0 && duration <= MAX_SESSION_DURATION
    end

    def compute_hmac(user_id, issued_at, expires_at, nonce)
      data = [user_id.length, user_id, issued_at, expires_at, nonce].pack("na*NNa16")
      OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('SHA256', @secret_key, data)
    end

    def secure_compare(a, b)
      return false unless a.bytesize == b.bytesize
      OpenSSL::secure_compare(a, b)
    end

    def token_revoked?(token)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        token_id = OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.digest(token.serialize)
        @revoked_tokens.key?(token_id)
      end
    end
  end

  class SecureAPIServer
    def initialize(host, port, cert_file, key_file, ca_file, secret_key)
      @host = host
      @port = port
      @token_authority = TokenAuthority.new(secret_key)
      @ssl_ctx = build_ssl_context(cert_file, key_file, ca_file)
      @request_log = []
      @log_mutex = Mutex.new
    end

    def start
      tcp_server = TCPServer.new(@host, @port)
      ssl_server = OpenSSL::SSL::SSLServer.new(tcp_server, @ssl_ctx)
      ssl_server.start_immediately = true

      loop do
        Thread.new(ssl_server.accept) do |client|
          handle_client(client)
        end
      end
    rescue => e
      log_event("Server error: #{e.class}")
    end

    private

    def build_ssl_context(cert_file, key_file, ca_file)
      ctx = OpenSSL::SSL::SSLContext.new
      ctx.min_version = OpenSSL::SSL::TLS1_2_VERSION
      ctx.cert = OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new(File.read(cert_file))
      ctx.key = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(File.read(key_file))
      ctx.ca_file = ca_file
      ctx.verify_mode = OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_PEER | OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_FAIL_IF_NO_PEER_CERT
      ctx.ciphers = 'ECDHE+AESGCM:!aNULL:!MD5:!RC4'
      ctx
    end

    def handle_client(client)
      request = read_request(client)
      return unless request

      case request[:action]
      when 'LOGIN'
        handle_login(client, request)
      when 'ACCESS'
        handle_access(client, request)
      when 'LOGOUT'
        handle_logout(client, request)
      else
        send_response(client, { status: 'error', message: 'unknown_action' })
      end
    rescue => e
      log_event("Client error: #{e.class}")
    ensure
      client.close rescue nil
    end

    def handle_login(client, request)
      user_id = request[:user_id]
      password = request[:password]

      unless authenticate_user(user_id, password)
        send_response(client, { status: 'error', message: 'auth_failed' })
        return
      end

      token = @token_authority.issue_token(user_id)
      encoded_token = Base64.strict_encode64(token.serialize)
      send_response(client, { status: 'ok', token: encoded_token })
    end

    def handle_access(client, request)
      encoded_token = request[:token]
      return send_response(client, { status: 'error', message: 'no_token' }) unless encoded_token

      begin
        token_data = Base64.strict_decode64(encoded_token)
        token = SessionToken.deserialize(token_data)
      rescue
        return send_response(client, { status: 'error', message: 'malformed_token' })
      end

      result = @token_authority.validate_token(token)
      if result[:valid]
        resource = fetch_resource(request[:resource], result[:user_id])
        send_response(client, { status: 'ok', data: resource })
      else
        send_response(client, { status: 'error', message: result[:reason].to_s })
      end
    end

    def handle_logout(client, request)
      encoded_token = request[:token]
      return send_response(client, { status: 'error', message: 'no_token' }) unless encoded_token

      begin
        token_data = Base64.strict_decode64(encoded_token)
        token = SessionToken.deserialize(token_data)
      rescue
        return send_response(client, { status: 'error', message: 'malformed_token' })
      end

      @token_authority.revoke_token(token)
      send_response(client, { status: 'ok', message: 'logged_out' })
    end

    def authenticate_user(user_id, password)
      return false unless user_id && password
      return false unless user_id.match?(/\A[a-zA-Z0-9._@-]+\z/)
      return false if user_id.bytesize > 255 || password.bytesize > 1024
      # In production: bcrypt/argon2 comparison against stored hash
      stored_hash = lookup_password_hash(user_id)
      return false unless stored_hash
      BCrypt::Password.new(stored_hash) == password
    end

    def lookup_password_hash(user_id)
      # Placeholder - would query secure credential store
      nil
    end

    def fetch_resource(resource_id, user_id)
      return nil unless resource_id&.match?(/\A[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+\z/)
      { resource_id: resource_id, owner: user_id, data: 'protected_content' }
    end

    def read_request(client)
      line = client.gets("\n", 4096)
      return nil unless line
      JSON.parse(line.strip, symbolize_names: true)
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      nil
    end

    def send_response(client, data)
      client.puts(JSON.generate(data))
    end

    def log_event(msg)
      @log_mutex.synchronize do
        @request_log << { time: Time.now.to_i, msg: msg }
        @request_log.shift if @request_log.size > 10000
      end
    end
  end
end
